title: Nouveau-Pad
subtitle: A 4-key macropad built around a Seeed XIAO RP2040
description: A compact macropad with four mechanical switches, an OLED display, a rotary encoder, and SK6812 MINI-E LEDs.

content.heading: About Nouveau-Pad
content.text: Nouveau-Pad is a compact 4-key macropad designed around the Seeed XIAO RP2040.

content.heading: Open Source
content.text: The repository includes the PCB design, CAD files, production files, and firmware.
